summary: Eldorado Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 27, 2026, announcing the publication of its 2025 Sustainability Report covering ESG performance for the period ending December 31, 2025. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report and does not involve any corporate transaction, activist campaign, or structural change. No financial terms, stakes, prices, or board recommendations are present. The report highlights sustainability metrics but constitutes standard disclosure, not a special situation. There are no risk-arb or event-driven considerations.
